Microsoft.title: The patch window is collapsing: Why security needs a new control plane | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: The patch window is collapsing: Why security needs a new control plane | Microsoft Azure Blog
Microsoft.summary:
Mission-critical applications power revenue-generating services, customer experiences, and core business operations that cannot simply be taken offline whenever a security update becomes available.
The patch window is collapsing: Why security needs a new control plane For decades, cybersecurity defenders have relied on a relatively straightforward model: a vulnerability is disclosed, security teams assess exposure, test available fixes, deploy patches into production, and ultimately close the risk before attackers can exploit it at scale.
Security researchers and attackers alike needed to analyze documentation, understand exploit conditions, study affected software, and develop attack techniques.

NVIDIA.title: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion Expands With NVHBM Custom High-Bandwidth Memory
NVIDIA.titleEn: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion Expands With NVHBM Custom High-Bandwidth Memory
NVIDIA.summary:
By integrating the memory controller into the 3D HBM stack instead of the XPU, NVHBM delivers up to 30% greater memory bandwidth and 15% lower HBM power consumption, and frees up to 25% more area on XPU compute die compared with standard HBM4E.
Offered with each generation of NVIDIA’s rack-scale system architecture, NVLink Fusion allows hyperscalers and AI-native companies to focus engineering resources on XPU innovation while using a proven technology stack for scale-up and scale-out networking, rack-scale systems and software — creating a faster, lower-risk path to deploying semi-custom AI infrastructure.
Amazon’s Annapurna Labs will work with NVIDIA on NVHBM technology and the NVLink scale-up architecture to enhance performance and efficiency for AI workloads.

NVIDIA.summary:
Hyperscalers and AI-native companies building custom XPUs must consider not just XPU design, but the design and development of the entire AI platform, including scale-up and scale-out networking, rack-scale architecture, production factory software and a robust supplier ecosystem.
NVLink Fusion delivers on that need, connecting XPUs to NVIDIA’s world-leading AI infrastructure to increase performance, accelerate time to market and mitigate risk for semi-custom AI factories.
NVLink Fusion also includes NVIDIA NVLink-C2C for connecting XPUs to NVIDIA Vera CPUs or other ecosystem CPUs, delivering up to 6x the energy efficiency of a PCIe interface — helping remove barriers between control and compute for agentic systems.

Anthropic.title: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against universal jailbreaks
Anthropic.titleEn: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against universal jailbreaks
Anthropic.summary:
At the same time, our Constitutional Classifiers did not substantially increase the over-refusal rate on harmless user queries: with the classifiers, Claude had a slightly increased refusal rate (by 0.38%), but this was not statistically significant in a random sample of 5,000 conversations.
Constitutional Classifiers may not prevent every universal jailbreak, though we believe that even the small proportion of jailbreaks that make it past our classifiers require far more effort to discover when the safeguards are in use.
Historically, jailbreaks have proved difficult to detect and block: these kinds of attacks were described over 10 years ago , yet to our knowledge there are still no fully robust deep-learning models in production.

Databricks.title: Choosing Data Governance Tools for Enterprise Data Governance | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Choosing Data Governance Tools for Enterprise Data Governance | Databricks Blog
Databricks.summary:
Data governance tools are software platforms that help organizations catalog, secure, monitor, and audit their data assets so that data stays accurate, discoverable, and compliant with regulatory requirements.
Platform-Native: Choosing Your Approach Data Governance Tools and the New AI Governance Requirement A Practical Framework for Choosing a Data Governance Tool Data governance tools enforce access control, data quality checks, and lineage tracking at the platform layer, blocking unauthorized or corrupted data before it reaches analytics, BI, and AI/ML workloads.
Evaluation criteria such as policy enforcement granularity and AI/agent governance vary widely across data governance tools, and as autonomous agents query production data directly, tool-level governance coverage becomes critical to preventing unsanctioned data access.

Mistral AI.summary:
Despite a deluge of political chatter about creating a sovereign European AI offering, the bloc has lagged both the US and China in investment and innovation.
Geoeconomics expert Shahin Vallee from the German Council on Foreign Relations said that a pivot to “AI adoption rather than innovation” therefore represented “the right strategy for Mistral and for Europe”.
AI race contender’s decision to offer GLM-5.2 a sign of how European political and commercial incentives can pull in different directions Mistral’s model of choice is GLM-5.2, an open-weight large language model developed by Zhipu, also known as Z.ai, one of China’s six “AI tiger” companies, included since 2025 on the US’ entity list because of national security concerns regarding military modernisation.

Hugging Face.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original

Hugging Face.summary:
The idea that a 4-bit model can actually outperform the full-precision version turns the usual assumption about quantization completely upside down....
Our latest paper, Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs , asks a question that the field has mostly left open: once a model has already been through structural compression, not just quantization, how well does that recovery step actually work, and what is the right way to do it?
Turning a heavily compressed 4-bit model into something that can outperform its larger full-precision counterpart is the kind of result that makes you rethink what "compression" actually means.

Hugging Face.title: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built
Hugging Face.summary:
Granite 4.2 models are built on a decoder-only dense transformer architecture with the following core components: Attention: Grouped Query Attention (GQA) with 40 attention heads and 8 KV heads Position Embedding: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) with θ = 10,000,000 Embeddings: Separate input/output embeddings (not tied) Granite 4.2 is trained from scratch on approximately 15 trillion tokens using a five-phase training strategy.
Each phase uses a distinct data mixture and learning-rate schedule, gradually shifting from broad web-scale data toward more curated, high-quality sources.
Every model can produce a chain of thought before its answer and can run in thinking or non-thinking mode depending on how much deliberation a task needs.

Writer.title: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
Writer.titleEn: WRITER Named a Market Shaper in the July 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™ for AI Agents for Marketing — Startup Vendors
Writer.titleKo: 작가는 2026년 7월 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant™에서 마케팅용 AI 에이전트 부문의 Market Shaper로 선정됨 · — 스타트업 공급업체
Writer.summary:
According to Gartner, “Market Shapers are ushering in a new era of industrialized, autonomous revenue engines, combining enterprise-grade governance, compliance and data security with frontier AI innovation, empowering marketing teams to move beyond pilots to scalable, autonomous agent orchestration as the new standard for modern GTM execution.”
WRITER believes it is at the forefront of this shift, combining powerful agent capabilities with an enterprise-grade platform that turns an organization’s expertise into shared infrastructure the whole team can use, connects go-to-market work, and keeps outputs on-brand, compliant, and supervised as agentic AI scales.
In WRITER’s view, the report captures a critical moment as marketing and revenue teams move beyond automating isolated tasks to reshape the customer journey itself – a shift that requires more than capable models or copilots that make individuals faster.

Writer.title: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleEn: How to show up where AI is listening: Building AI visibility from buyer conversations
Writer.titleKo: AI가 듣고 있는 곳에 표시하는 방법 · 구매자 대화를 통해 AI 가시성 구축
Writer.summary:
You’re building content from the exact language they use, at the speed your buyers expect, in the voice your market recognizes.
It means deciding which questions matter most, building PR and communications around those questions, showing up in the social and review platforms AI reads, and making sure your story is consistent across every surface where AI forms an opinion about your brand.
Marketbridge analyzed more than 17,000 AI citations across multiple industries and reached the same conclusion: “Organizations that treat GEO as a technical add-on risk missing the bigger picture.”
